blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – The House of Representatives prosecution team on Thursday challenged Vice President Sara Duterte’s claim that she did not recall participating in transactions involving multi-million-peso joint bank accounts with her father, former president Rodrigo Roa Duterte. Private prosecutor Benjamin “Jay” Tolosa Jr. said the Senate impeachment court would weigh that explanation against the amounts involved, the repeated transactions, and bank documents bearing the Vice President’s signature. “The court will determine the strength of that evidence in case ‘yan ang magiging defense na gagamitin nila (that will be their defense),” Tolosa said in a press briefing.
